title: Accounting
subtitle: Accounts, income and expenses, payroll and taxes for the tax office

overview.bankIncomeHint: Client payments and other income for the month
overview.inUzs: For the month, in UZS, excluding transfers

operations.title: Operations
operations.subtitle: Income and expenses by account, transfers between own accounts
operations.totalsHint: Totals for the filter, excluding transfers
operations.emptyText: Add income or an expense, or load payments from the CRM.
operations.manualClientHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM arrive here automatically. Enter manually only payments that are not in the CRM.
operations.periodHint: The month the salary or tax is paid for
operations.transferHint: For example, a cash withdrawal from the bank account: the expense on one account and the income on the other are created together.
operations.transferNeedsTwo: A transfer needs at least two active accounts.
operations.amountToHint: Only if the account currencies differ
operations.deleteHint: The operation stays in the audit log with the reason. A transfer is deleted as a whole (both parts).
operations.manageArticles: Add your own income and expense items

import.title: Load payments from CRM
import.text: Confirmed client payments and refunds for the period go to the accounts that have the payment method ticked. Payments already loaded are not repeated.

bank.title: Bank statement import
bank.subtitle: Account turnover from the bank file: income and expenses go to the chosen account
bank.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV up to 5 MB: an account statement or an operations export from the bank app.
bank.autoAccount: Detect by the account number in the statement
bank.accountHint: If the statement has an account number, the account with the same number is used. For a bank app export, choose the account.
bank.how1: Download a statement for any period from the bank and upload it here.
bank.how2: Check the preview: categories are suggested from the payment purpose (taxes, IT Park, bank fees, salary, client payments) and can be changed.
bank.how3: Rows already imported are not added again, so periods may overlap.
bank.how4: Manually entered operations with the same date and amount are marked as possible duplicates and are not imported unless you tick them.
bank.matched: Account found by the number from the statement.
bank.noMatch: No account with number {number} — choose an account or enter this number in the account card.
bank.chooseAccount: Choose the account to import operations into.
bank.otherNumber: The statement has a different account number: {number}. Check that the account is correct.
bank.possibleHint: “Possible duplicate” means this account already has a manually entered operation with the same date, type and amount. Such rows are unticked; tick them if they are different payments.
bank.categoryHint: For salary and taxes, set the month the payment is for (default — the operation month). A transfer counts as neither income nor expense.
bank.running: The import is still running — refresh the page in a minute.
bank.checkDiff: The account balance differs from the statement by {diff}. Check the account opening balance and manually entered operations.

errors.format: The statement was not recognized: no table with “Debit/Credit turnover” or “Turi/Summa/Sana” columns.
errors.account: The account is inactive or not found — choose an active account

accounts.title: Accounts and wallets
accounts.subtitle: Bank accounts, cash and cards. Balance = opening balance + income − expenses
accounts.name: Name
accounts.openingDateHint: Operations before this date cannot be entered
accounts.crmMethodsHint: Payments confirmed in the CRM with these methods land in this account automatically
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete the account? Only possible while it has no operations.
accounts.balanceHint: An account with operations cannot be deleted — deactivate it instead. A deactivated account accepts no new operations or CRM payments.
accounts.emptyText: Add a bank account, cash desk or card — then you can enter operations.

categories.title: Income and expense items
categories.subtitle: Your own items for operations — each one is counted as one of the base categories
categories.intro: For example, “Warehouse rent” (Expense → Rent) or “Deposit interest” (Income → Other income). Items appear in the “Income or expense” form, the operations list, the overview and the Excel export.
categories.name: Name
categories.baseHint: Defines taxes, the IT Park base and annual report lines: for example, “Expense → Rent” or “Income → Other income”.
categories.baseChangeHint: The new value applies to new operations; operations already entered keep their previous category.
categories.emptyTextIN: Add your own income item — it will appear in the operation form.
categories.emptyTextOUT: Add your own expense item — it will appear in the operation form.
categories.directionLocked: The item has operations — its type cannot change.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete the item? This is possible only while it has no operations.
categories.footer: An item with operations cannot be deleted — it can be deactivated. An inactive item is not offered for new operations; existing operations keep it.
categories.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. If a word appears in the payment purpose or counterparty, a bank statement row gets this item on import. For example: “warehouse, Chilonzor”.

people.title: People for the tax office
people.subtitle: Who is officially employed: salary, PINFL, hire and termination dates
people.deleteConfirm: Delete this person? If there are accruals or payments, make them inactive instead.
people.emptyText: Add the people declared to the tax office to calculate payroll and taxes.

payroll.title: Tax payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly accrual, NDFL and INPS, paid and remaining
payroll.approveConfirm: Approve all drafts of the month? Approved rows can no longer be changed.
payroll.inpsWithin: INPS is withheld within NDFL: net = gross − NDFL.
payroll.inpsOnTop: INPS is withheld on top of NDFL: net = gross − NDFL − INPS.
payroll.grossHint: Salary on file: {salary}. Taxes will be recalculated.
payroll.paidWithoutAccrual: Payments without an accrual for this month
payroll.hint: “Calculate month” creates drafts for active people employed in the month (prorated by calendar days when hired or terminated mid-month). Approved rows are not recalculated. Paid = “Salary” expenses with this person and period.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.subtitle: Calculated automatically from the month’s payroll and receipts
taxes.draftsWarning: The month’s payroll is not approved (drafts: {count}) — amounts may change.
taxes.noPayroll: Payroll for the month is not calculated yet:

how.TAX_NDFL: NDFL from the payroll (minus INPS when INPS is within NDFL)
how.TAX_ITPARK: From client payments and other income on bank accounts

taxes.hint: Rates: NDFL {ndfl}%, INPS {inps}%, IT Park {itpark}% — change them in accounting settings. Paid = expenses of the matching category with this period.

settings.title: Accounting settings
settings.subtitle: Tax rates for payroll and tax calculation
settings.inpsWithinNdflHint: Off by default: personal income tax 7.5% and INPS 0.1% are withheld separately, net = gross − PIT − INPS. Turn on if INPS is included in PIT (PIT payable = PIT − INPS).
settings.itparkHint: Of the month’s receipts on bank accounts

errors.category: This category cannot be used for this operation
errors.personRequired: Choose who the salary was paid to
errors.periodRequired: Choose the month the payment is for
errors.accountInactive: The account is deactivated or not found
errors.beforeOpening: The date is before the account opening balance date ({date})
errors.amountToRequired: The account currencies differ — enter the amount credited
errors.crmLocked: A CRM operation can only be reversed in the CRM (payment refund)
errors.currencyLocked: The currency of an account with operations cannot be changed
errors.accountHasOperations: The account has operations — it can only be deactivated
errors.personHasRecords: There are accruals or payments — make the person inactive
errors.firedBeforeHired: The termination date is before the hire date
errors.pinflTaken: A person with this PINFL already exists
errors.payrollApproved: An approved accrual cannot be changed
errors.noUsdRate: No USD rate — USD account amounts were not converted to UZS. Add the rate in references.
errors.articleInvalid: The item is inactive, not found or belongs to another operation type
errors.articleBase: Choose a base category for this operation type
errors.articleNameTaken: An item with this name already exists
errors.articleUsed: The item has operations — it can only be deactivated
errors.articleDirectionLocked: The item has operations — its type (income or expense) cannot change
errors.keywordsLong: Too many keywords — up to 500 characters

annual.hint: Excel for the tax office: Form 1 (balance sheet at the start and end of the year), Form 2 (financial results), taxes and payroll by month, cash flow by account
